description: List the user's introductions: accepted ones with an open chat (including the free weekly curated match), requests waiting on the user, and requests the user sent that have not been answered yet. Use this for any question like "did anyone reply", "any new intros", "is anything waiting on me" or "who have I connected with". Each item includes the match_id, the other member, status, last message and unread count.
